appBar.editModeBody: Playback is running. Playback will stop when entering Edit mode.
appBar.sessionModeBody: All loaded tracks will be unloaded. You can reload them when you return.
appBar.leaveSessionBody: The loaded session will be closed and playback will stop.
appBar.leaveSessionDirtyBody: The session has unsaved edits. Leaving will discard them.

topStrip.cueMixHint: CUE/MIX: blend cue signal with master output in headphones

limiter.title: MASTER LIMITER
limiter.hint: Prevents digital clipping on the master output. Disable only if using an external limiter.

nudge.title: NUDGE SENSITIVITY
nudge.hint: Speed offset applied while holding a nudge key or button.

pitch.title: PITCH RANGE
pitch.hint: Maximum pitch slider deviation from original BPM.

buffer.title: AUDIO BUFFER SIZE
buffer.hint: Frames per audio callback. Smaller values reduce latency but increase CPU load. Changing this causes a brief audio gap.

bpmRange.title: BPM DETECTION RANGE
bpmRange.hint: Tracks detected outside this range will be doubled or halved until they fit. Useful for genres with tempos outside the 90-180 default.

recording.title: RECORDING FORMAT
recording.hintWav16: Uncompressed PCM. Standard CD quality, smaller files than 32-bit.
recording.hintWav32: Uncompressed 32-bit float. Full dynamic range, largest files.
recording.hintFlac: Lossless compression, encoded after you stop. Same quality as WAV, smaller files.
recording.hintSession: Records only the event log. No audio file is saved. You can render to WAV or FLAC later from the session view.
recording.bmsHint: Saves a .bms file with a full event log of every action taken during the set. Required for rendering or replaying a session.

deckCount.title: DEFAULT DECK COUNT
deckCount.hint: Number of active decks. Takes effect immediately and is remembered across sessions.

keyboard.title: KEYBOARD MAPPING
keyboard.hint: Click or press Enter to remap. Arrow keys navigate. Delete resets to default. Double-click also resets.
keyboard.pressKey: Press any key. Esc to cancel

browser.clearBody: All tracks will be removed. Playlists are not affected. This cannot be undone.
browser.dropHint: Drop audio files or folders here, or use ADD FILES / ADD FOLDER
browser.noPlaylists: No playlists yet. Click NEW PLAYLIST to get started.
browser.emptyPlaylist: Empty. Add tracks from the section below.
browser.deletePlaylistBody: This cannot be undone. Tracks in your collection are not affected.
browser.removeTrackBody: The track will be removed from your collection along with its saved BPM and grid data.

deck.loadBody: Playback will stop and the current track will be replaced.
deck.label: DECK {id}
deck.dragHint: Drag a track from the collection

editView.dropHint: Drop a track from the collection

session.dropHint: Drop a recorded session here, or click to open
session.noTrackInfo: No track info. Load tracks in Performance mode first, then record.
session.discardBody: The session has unsaved edits. Ejecting will discard them.
session.missingFiles: These audio files are missing. Choose the folder that contains them to restore playback:

quitModal.bodySession: The session is currently playing. Quit anyway?
quitModal.bodyDirty: The session has unsaved edits. Quit anyway?
